messages.subject: Non-normal latent factors
parts:
Hi, 

I would like to estimate a model where the latent factors are distributed as a mixture of normals in order to get a more flexible approximation of their distribution. Is this something possible with the lavaan package? 

Thank you for your help. 

Sarah

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Non-normal latent factors
parts: I would like to estimate a model where the latent factors are distributed as a mixture of normals in order to get a more flexible approximation of their distribution. Is this something possible with the lavaan package?

If you use the blavaan package (Bayesian lavaan) to generate a JAGS file from your lavaan syntax, then you can change the JAGS file to model the latents with mixture distributions.

Terrence D. Jorgensen
Postdoctoral Researcher, Methods and Statistics
Research Institute for Child Development and Education, the University of Amsterdam
UvA web page: http://www.uva.nl/profile/t.d.jorgensen
